```{r}
library(readxl)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
Access_Log_Activity <- read_excel("~/Downloads/Access Log Activity.xlsx")



```

```{r}
Access_Log_Activity <- read_excel("~/Downloads/Access Log Activity.xlsx")

apps <- c("CHROME", "CALENDAR_APP", "DOCS_APP",
          "GMAIL_APP", "OTHER_APP", "SAFARI")
#geom_text(data = medians,
          #aes(app, median_per_day, label = median_per_day),
          #vjust = -2.5, size = 3.5, inherit.aes = FALSE)

daily <- Access_Log_Activity %>%
mutate(
  app = str_extract(str_trim(`User Agent String`), "^[A-Z_]+(?=\\.)"),
    day = as.Date(`Activity Timestamp`)
  ) %>%
  filter(app %in% apps) %>%
  count(app, day)


ggplot(daily, aes(app, n, fill = app)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Gezelle's Distribution of Daily Computer Activity by App",
    subtitle = str_wrap(
      "Chrome was the highest with a median of about 12,280 events per day, followed by Gmail (811) and Docs (366). Calendar, Other Apps, and Safari were used far less.",
      width = 90),
    caption = paste0("Author: Gezelle  |  Date created: ",
                     format(Sys.Date(), "%B 18, %Y"),
                     "  |  Data source: Access Log Activity.xlsx from Google Takeout"),
    x = "",
    y = "# of Times in App"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r}


daily <- Access_Log_Activity %>%
  mutate(
    app = str_extract(str_trim(`User Agent String`), "^[A-Z_]+(?=\\.)"),
    day = as.Date(`Activity Timestamp`)
  ) %>%
  filter(app %in% apps) %>%
  count(app, day) %>%
  mutate(app = fct_reorder(app, n, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE))   # <- new line

ggplot(daily, aes(app, n, fill = app)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_y_log10() +
   labs(
    title = "Gezelle's Distribution of Daily Computer Activity by App",
    subtitle = str_wrap(
      "Chrome was the highest with a median of about 12,280 events per day, followed by Gmail (811) and Docs (366). Calendar, Other Apps, and Safari were used far less.",
      width = 90),
    caption = paste0("Author: Gezelle  |  Date created: ",
                     format(Sys.Date(), "%B 18, %Y"),
                     "  |  Data source: Access Log Activity.xlsx from Google Takeout"),
    x = "",
    y = "# of Times in App"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
